description: Utility helper functions for handling credits data, including extracting credits used from API responses and formatting numerical credit values for display.

methods.name: getCreditsUsed(details)
methods.description: Safely extracts the number of credits used from an API response object, with fallback to alternative property names and nested data, returning null if not available or not a finite number.

methods.name: formatCredits(value, locale = undefined)
methods.description: Formats a numerical credits value into a locale-aware string with controlled decimal precision, returning a placeholder if input is null or undefined.
